market_summary: London morning session displays mixed, consolidating price action across all four assets. EURUSD and GBPUSD have pushed into upper ATR bands and session highs on divergent bearish/neutral CVD with sub-2.0 RVOL, indicating exhaustion rather than clean breakouts. US100 remains locked in mid-range Value Area chop around VWAP and POC prior to the New York open. BTCUSD staged a low-volume liquidity sweep below its session low but lacks order-flow confirmation to justify a counter-trend reversal. All setups currently fail minimum confluence criteria, warranting a disciplined HOLD across the board.

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: (1) Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10766 to VAH 1.10981) and trading below POC 1.10946, creating mean-reversion pull toward POC. (2) CVD is NEUTRAL (+651) with negative slope (-646), showing fading buyer pressure. (3) Session is LONDON_SESSION, active. (4) Price is above VWAP (1.10842) and EMA50 (1.10873), showing short-term structural reclaim. (5) ATR channel position is near upper band (1.10953), signaling extended/stretched conditions. (6) RVOL is 1.619, below the 2.0 breakout threshold. (7) Price is rejecting just below Session High (1.10988) and POC. With neutral CVD divergence and price stalled below resistance inside Value Area, edge is weak.
signals.level_event: rejection / below Session High 1.10988 and POC 1.10946

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: (1) Price is testing above VAH (1.32729) and above POC (1.32577). (2) CVD is BEARISH (-2,745) with negative slope (-318), showing sharp divergence against the upward push. (3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. (4) Price is above VWAP (1.32657) and EMA50 (1.32690). (5) Price is testing the upper ATR band (1.32784), indicating extended conditions. (6) RVOL is 1.833, lacking the yellow >2.0 volume confirmation. (7) Signal candle rejected off 1.32769 approaching Session High 1.32809. The heavy CVD bearish divergence right at upper ATR band warrants caution against buying a breakout.
signals.level_event: rejection / holding at VAH 1.32729 below Session High 1.32809

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: (1) Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28067.71 to VAH 28166.71) and slightly above POC 28112.50. (2) CVD is BEARISH (-3.27) with negative slope (-0.8). (3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. (4) Price is crossing VWAP (28126.67) but remains below descending EMA50 (28161.46). (5) ATR bands are contracting, with price consolidating mid-channel between 28017.27 and 28213.97. (6) RVOL is 1.091; no yellow spikes (noting US100 caveat, but no alternative volume expansion exists). (7) Price is chopping between S/R support 28083.64 and VAH/EMA50 resistance overhead. GEX is null. Mid-channel consolidation inside Value Area requires a wait.
signals.level_event: acceptance / hovering around VWAP 28126.67 and POC 28112.50

signals.rationale: Evaluating confluence: (1) Price is below VAL 73426.10 and below POC 73527.85. (2) CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with flat slope, lacking aggressive directional flow. (3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. (4) Price is well below VWAP (73641.85) and EMA50 (73667.67). (5) Price is bouncing from lower ATR band (73163.03) after forming bar pushed to 73166.00 and was bought back up. (6) RVOL is very low at 0.46, meaning the breakdown lacked exchange volume conviction and is prone to a false break/sweep. (7) Price swept Session Low (73204.10) to 73166.00 and is now reclaiming S/R 73284.60. However, entering counter-trend against below-VAL structure without bullish CVD confirmation carries insufficient edge.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: sweep / liquidity sweep of Session Low 73204.10 into forming pinbar
